title: MoU between MoSPI and Ashoka University to Strengthen Academic and Institutional collaboration
body_text: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) and Ashoka University signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in New Delhi on 27th November 2026. The occasion was graced by Dr. Saurabh Garg, Secretary, MoSPI; Shri Purnendu Kishore Banerjee, Director General (Data Governance), MoSPI; Dr. Prachi Mishra, Dean, Ashoka University; and senior officers of the Ministry. Shri R. Rajesh, Additional Director General, Capacity Development Division, MoSPI, and Shri Sachin Sharma, Registrar, Ashoka University signed the MoU. Ms. Reena Singh, DDG, NSSTA while moderating, emphasised that this collaboration would serve as foundation in bringing together two institutions sharing a common interest in advancing knowledge and strengthening institutional capacities for evidence based policy making. Dr. Saurabh Garg, in his address, emphasised the importance of developing an overarching framework for collaboration in communicating research, in addition to initiatives on training and applied research and build a coherent, integrated approach to data management and governance. He stressed the importance of fostering synergies between government institutions and academic organisations to leverage expertise promote innovation and strengthen the country's statistical ecosystem. The MoU envisages collaboration across a range of areas, including faculty exchange, exposure visits, collaborative research, sharing of academic resources and publications, organising joint seminars, conferences and workshops, customised short-term academic programme, etc. These initiatives are expected to facilitate mutual exchange of knowledge, expertise and ideas in emerging areas of statistics and data governance, while encouraging research and the development and adoption of innovative statistical methodologies. The MoU marks yet another step towards fostering stronger institutional linkages between statistical agencies and academic institutions in the endeavour to build a robust, responsive, innovative and future-ready National Statistical System. ******* Samrat
